property_summary: For every caller and recipient, if the contract has a positive balance then only calls made by the stored owner can transfer out the full balance via withdrawAll; the mutant inverts the access check so a non-owner caller can drain the balance, violating this property for some caller/recipient inputs.
change_summary: Replace the require condition to check that msg.sender is NOT the owner, reversing the access control so only non-owners can call withdrawAll.
